title: 0031. Standardized figure crop rectangle, applied by default
summary: Chose a fixed figure crop rectangle (1940x1080 at x=300) applied by default to every lecture's embedded figures; amended by ADR 0044 to default to no crop.
scope: lecture recording layout (2560x1080 canvas, webcam pillarbox)
notes: Status reads Accepted, but the status line states it is amended by ADR 0044, which changes the default to no crop; the Decision section describes the superseded default. ADR 0044 is referenced by number only (no path) and is not among the classified inputs.
